ambiguity_detection.description: If |score_tag_A - score_tag_B| < threshold, mark as ambiguous and defer to NMR

exception_learning.description: Rule fires -> Vector disagrees -> NMR retracts -> Store (rule_id, word, correct_POS) -> Next occurrence: rule automatically weakened

conflict_resolver.description: Suppress weak noun hypotheses before DS fusion when a higher-priority rule also fires
